bullets.text: The government plans to build free houses on land purchased under the LIG scheme in Tharamani, and the office should monitor housing board developments.
A world-class riverfront plan may face delays as garbage piles up on Chennai beaches, and the office should watch sanitation efforts.
A person died mysteriously in a Uthukottai lodge operating without rules and whose CCTV password management is unknown, so the office should inspect local lodging compliance.
Authorities removed highway encroachments in Gummidipoondi bazaar with police protection, and the office should review ongoing clearance drives.
The Avadi Central Crime Branch arrested a couple for swindling ₹7.16 crore using forged documents, and the office should track fraud investigations.
Coimbatore could add 125 GCCs by 2032 according to an EY and CII report, and the office should support regional IT ecosystem growth.
The Kerala Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Bureau will use AI to detect corruption under Project Zero, and the office should monitor digital anti-corruption initiatives.
Andhra Pradesh showcased AI use in public administration at an iGOT workshop, and the office should review e-governance applications.
